summary: A Sharjah medical and dental centre appears to lose new patients to a free builder address, an empty email label and no online booking or WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was created by CattyMedia.
findings.cost: A free builder address and an agency banner look temporary for a centre founded in 2016.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean header.

findings.problem: The contact section appears to show an empty E-mail label above the real email, and the fax number appears to be the same as the phone number.
findings.cost: Small errors in the contact section are where a patient decides to call, and they erode trust.

findings.problem: The menu appears to be full of BMI and calorie calculators, and a service called Upcoming Services appears.
findings.cost: Patients came to book a doctor, and calculators and empty promises hide your dental and doctor services.
findings.fix: Doctor and dental pages first, with clear booking.

findings.problem: No online booking and no WhatsApp appear, only a phone number.
findings.cost: Patients who want an appointment out of hours cannot book, and they book where they can.
findings.fix: Online booking on the page and a WhatsApp button.
